name: R88_AnalysisClosure
scope: analysis paper child only; no manuscript changes
question: How does native request-vs-uniform retention difference depend on spatial direction and the realized per-step amplitude profile?

sample.population: Fresh local edits with nonempty official preserved region; remaining category-9 style cases have no such region after 90 historical exclusions; no claim of full PIE category coverage

fixed.memory: source K/V, paired, all image queries, gate=1, steps[0,7), blocks1..26; identical in all six arms

arms.probe: same recipient image/source prompt/reference; fixed wrong target from within-category donor; actual edit uses original true target

interpretation: Profile origin is the second factor, not a pre-assumed scalar high/low dose. Report stepwise crossing and cumulative impulse separately.
The two decomposition paths are arithmetic within the same cohort, not a unique additive causal percentage.
Wrong-target response tests the frozen donor construction; histogram matching does not match all spatial morphology.
Global controls apply nonzero correction; never describe GLB as no correction.
Preservation metrics do not establish whole-instruction success; nonsignificant CLIP does not establish equivalence.
No outcome-based resampling, winner selection, optional stopping, or substitute test family. All six arms run on the frozen cohort.
All conclusions are conditional on this editor, backbone, resolution and profile construction; external methods and new backbones are not implemented in this round.

source_selection.eligible: valid prompts, nonempty official edited and preserved regions
source_selection.dedupe: RGB exact hash or dHash<=8 with 64x64 thumbnail RGB MAE<=12; exclude historical90 and within-cohort duplicates
source_selection.donors: fixed same-category cyclic derangement of SHA256 donor order, smallest shift with different target prompts

statistics: stats_plan.json; must be frozen with manifest and code BEFORE server generation; package timestamp is not a public registry

runtime_budget.savings_to_verify: source probe reuse can save 3/group; source K/V capture reuse may save 7/dependent arm if exact reference state/conditioning/hooks match
runtime_budget.walltime: measure first completed source-seed group; no fixed hours claim

observations_to_save: per-step sigma/h/applied RMS and anchor target
standalone and actual incremental NFE separately
GPU seconds, CPU evaluation seconds, export seconds, peak allocated/reserved memory
raw metrics, source paired contrasts, exact prompts/donor IDs, structured failure status

delivery.compact_zip: previews/maps/scalars/config/statistics/code; native PNG retained in server results
delivery.pack: once after generation checkpoint and once after final metrics, atomic rename; never per image
delivery.direct_download_link: print Jupyter file URL for final ZIP using server base URL when available

speed_invariants: no fewer steps, lower resolution, quantization, changed attention backend or reduced evaluation coverage as a speed shortcut
cache only functions of an explicit immutable key; never reuse own-current-state c across diverging arms
CPU-side postprocessing may overlap after files commit; GPU processes use shared queue
reference implementation retained; optimized numerical equivalence recorded before production
